audit_items.proof_trace: The validateBlobsByRange function enforces only a minimum slot (Deneb fork) but no maximum slot (Fulu fork). After Fulu activation, the handler will serve blobs from post-Fulu slots, violating the invariant that blob_sidecars_by_range should only serve pre-Fulu blobs.
audit_items.attack_scenario: After Fulu fork activates, an attacker requests blobs with startSlot >= FuluForkEpoch via blob_sidecars_by_range RPC. The handler serves these post-Fulu blobs despite the endpoint being deprecated for post-Fulu data.
